note: Effective theorem ranges extracted from published literature. Only ranges with explicit, non-asymptotic constants are included. Asymptotic-only theorems (Pham-Sauermann, Bedert-Bucić-Kravitz-Montgomery-Müyesser general group bounds, Müyesser-Pokrovskiy) are excluded because their 'sufficiently large p' thresholds are not specified with effective numerical values.

ranges.reference: arXiv:2603.20961, Graham conjecture on small sets in abelian groups
ranges.notes: Proves |A| <= 20 for the additive cyclic group F_p, with A subset F_p \ {0}. This is an effective explicit bound for all primes.

ranges.reference: arXiv:2603.20961, Graham conjecture on small sets in abelian groups
ranges.notes: Proves |A| <= 22 for zero-sum subsets in any abelian group.

ranges.reference: arXiv:2409.07403, Graham's rearrangement conjecture beyond the rectification barrier
ranges.notes: Proves |A| <= exp((log p)^(1/4)) for ALL primes p (not just sufficiently large). This is the best fully effective small-set bound. For practical primes up to 10^12, this covers |A| <= 9, which is weaker than the Costa bound for small sets.

ranges.reference: Folklore / trivial: complements of size |B| <= 2 are trivially sequenceable
ranges.notes: When |B| <= 2, the complement is very small and valid orderings are easy to construct explicitly. This is a trivial folklore bound.
